name: toggle-menu-bar
title: Toggle Menu Bar
description: Switch between show/hide menu bar options
author: iamyeizi

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Menu Bar
commands.description: Toggle auto hide/show menu bar between two options of your choice.

commands.name: select-menu-bar-mode
commands.title: Set Menu Bar Mode
commands.description: Choose one of the four macOS menu bar visibility modes.

preferences.name: closeWindow
preferences.label: Close Raycast window
preferences.description: Should the main Raycast window close when triggering a command?

preferences.name: optionOne
preferences.title: Select option 1️⃣
preferences.description: Select "Automatically hide and show the menu bar" option.

preferences.name: optionTwo
preferences.title: Select option 2️⃣
preferences.description: Select "Automatically hide and show the menu bar" option.

scripts.build:native: xcrun clang -fobjc-arc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2 -arch arm64 -arch x86_64 -mmacosx-version-min=13.0 -framework Foundation native/menu-bar-auto-hide-native.m -o assets/menu-bar-auto-hide-native && codesign --force --sign - assets/menu-bar-auto-hide-native
scripts.build: npm run build:native && ray build -e dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Use npm run publish for the Raycast Store' && exit 1
